description: Config-format parity: comment rows, block groups and key_path for text formats. Cases carrying 'enforcement': 'expect_fail' pin behaviour that does not exist yet; the expect_fail count is this campaign's progress meter and the finish line is 0. Pins are of two kinds. OBSERVED: the current result was read live from the frozen corpus, so the case fails today for exactly the reason stated. DESIGN: block rows and key_path do not exist at all yet, so the expected shape is a commitment written into this file rather than a reading of anything. Every error-shaped expect_fail case (an unknown WHERE field is a hard error, not zero rows) has a hard twin running the same query minus the not-yet-existing clause, because expect_fail accepts ANY error and would otherwise pass just as happily on a typo.

steps.fql: FIND symbols WHERE fql_kind = 'comment' WHERE name LIKE '%west manifest file%' IN 'west.yml'

rows.name: # The west manifest file for upstream Zephyr.

steps.fql: FIND symbols WHERE fql_kind = 'comment' WHERE name LIKE '%zephyr-keep-sorted-stop%' IN 'west.yml'
FIND usages OF 'alphabetical' WHERE role = 'comment' IN 'west.yml'
FIND symbols WHERE fql_kind = 'comment' WHERE name = '/* CONFIG_PM_DEVICE_RUNTIME_ASYNC */' IN 'subsys/pm/device_runtime.c' ORDER BY line ASC LIMIT 30

cases.name: key_path_disambiguates_west_remote
cases.expect_fail_reason: DESIGN PIN, error-shaped: key_path is not a field yet, so this errors rather than returning rows. west.yml holds 12 pair rows all named 'remote'; only the one at line 19 sits under manifest.defaults. Sequence indices are deliberately absent from the path.

steps.fql: FIND symbols WHERE name = 'remote' WHERE fql_kind = 'pair' IN 'west.yml' ORDER BY line ASC LIMIT 60

cases.name: key_path_finds_container_image_reference
